newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Belgian bus crashes in Tyrol, 10 children injured.
newsitem.headline: Belgian bus crashes in Tyrol, 10 children injured.

text.p: A bus carrying a Belgian school group crashed on Tuesday in the western Austrian state of Tyrol, badly injuring 10 of the schoolchildren aboard, local police said.
The bus, carrying 50 people, crashed off the Gerlos road, which runs between the villages of Zell am Ziller to Mittersill, a Zell am Ziller police spokesman told Reuters.
Two of the injured were transported by helicopter to a nearby hospital. Further details were not immediately available.
